column1: # p348 — "authors" is a THREE-VALUED quantity and these shelves do not say which key they used.
# Found while re-verifying `terracotta-education/terracotta` at the pin: this base publishes
# "2 815 commits, 18 authors"; the commit count re-derives EXACTLY, and the author count does not
# re-derive at all under the obvious key.  At one pin, on one repository:
# An exact commit match beside a four-off author count is the signature of a DEFINITION difference,
# not of drift.  All three numbers are correct answers to different questions and none of them is
# labelled, so `recount` (T37, "re-derive every registered quantity from the rows") cannot judge an
# author cell at all: it has no key.
# It matters more than a bookkeeping nit for one reason: p346 lost the author-DOMAIN channel to a
# PII refusal, so a successor pass computing author counts will reach for %an — the key that needs
# no addresses — and will read every published author cell as too high.  The drift would look like
# 🟢 The fix is one word per cell.  This file measures the spread so the next pass knows its size.
